dedupe_keys.name: d2 2 dataset02 internal heat gains and occupancy schedules in offices schools and elderly homes

description: The hybridGEOTABS project deposits internal-heat-gain and occupancy schedule assumptions for offices, schools and elderly homes. Its Zenodo page says gains cover occupants, lighting and appliances and draw on standards, literature and an expert survey. The provider used these schedules when estimating heating and cooling demand curves for three building typologies in its hybrid ground-source HVAC assessment. A modeller could use the published assumptions as reference schedules or compare alternative demand profiles in building-energy simulations. Zenodo lists one public CC BY 4.0 PDF, not machine-readable schedule files or measured occupancy traces. The landing page does not report the hourly values, country-specific standards, uncertainty or how holidays and vacancy are represented. Those details require inspecting the document before quantitative reuse. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this schedule summary. The PDF was not downloaded, and no derived energy-demand curve was independently reproduced.
